messages:
Andrew: FYI the west-region GPU cluster is saturated. Free_slots trending to single digits and request queues are lengthening. p95 interactive latency up ~180ms and we've got some runaway long-chat jobs tying up slots. Anyone on for a quick mitigation plan?

Kira: Which mitigation levers are cheapest to flip right now? steer cross-region, clamp long-gen, or divert to distilled models locally?

Mohit: Cross-region is already kicking in and were seeing ~85ms added latency + noticeable egress charges. Billing spike: https://billing.redwood/2026/03/cluster-usage. We should avoid indiscriminate cross-region for free-tier traffic.

Samira: Short-term: mark long-gen requests as "interruptible" and cap token windows. E.g. if request.tokens > 12k, either enqueue in heavy-pool or return 429/Retry-After header. Quick to apply via admission hook.

Andrew: Proposal A (fast):
- admission soft-cap: token_limit=12k for interactive routes
- heavy_pool: separate queue for interruptible long-gen, concurrency=30, queue=150, longer timeout 180s
- fallback order: local-quantized -> regional-same -> regional-smaller
This prefers keeping work local to avoid egress and latency.

Kira: Add tiering: enterprise customers may use cross-region up to a budget; self-serve/free hits a hard reject when local utilization > 92%. Otherwise we get invoiced hard.

Mohit: Draft admission config: 
```
admission_controller:
  interactive:
    token_limit: 12000
    concurrency: 1200
  interruptible:
    token_limit: 60000
    concurrency: 30
    queue_capacity: 150
  overflow:
    fallback_order: [local_q8, regional_same, regional_fallback]
    cross_region_budget_qps: 200
    cross_region_cost_cap_per_min: 40.00
```

Samira: cross_region_budget should be a function of free_slots and per-tenant budget. e.g. allow cross_region if free_slots_in_home < 10 AND tenant has enterprise flag AND cumulative_cross_routed_tokens/min < cap. Make cap dynamic.

Andrew: Agreed. Add gate: allow_cross_region = tenant.allow_fallback && free_slots_home < CROSS_REGION_THRESHOLD && cost_this_min < cost_cap.

Lucas: If we send to quantized local models, add a lightweight QA sample of outputs (1% sampled) to the eval pipeline so we detect semantic regressions quickly. If quality delta > threshold, revert those tenants to regional_same.

Mohit: ops-bot: create flag "dynamic-capacity-steer" and expose API to toggle with reason.

ops-bot: Flag request acknowledged. Toggle example: curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/dynamic-capacity-steer/toggle -d '{"enabled":true,"actor":"Andrew","reason":"west saturation 1796009999"}'

Samira: Quick curl to isolate long-gen route while we watch: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/admission -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"/v1/generate/long","concurrency_limit":20,"token_limit":16000,"response_on_reject":"retry-after"}'
```

Andrew: Ops please apply that for a 15m window then revert. We want to observe impact without permanent policy drift.

deploy-bot: change-request submitted: admission patch -> canary -> prod. ID: pr-4763

Mohit: Canary applied at 3 nodes. Observed: heavy queue length decreased in 45s, p95 interactive dropped ~130ms. Cross-region rps down 37%.

Kira: Nice. Can we also emit a metric cost_per_routed_token and surface it to billing alerts? If cost_per_routed_token * cross_region_tokens_this_min > 30$ then block cross-region for self-serve.

Lucas: QA note: prepping a 100-sample diff check for quantized fallback. Will post results in 20m. If mismatch rate > 3% escalate.

Samira: Suggest adding a small backoff header for queued interruptible requests so clients can backoff early (Retry-After + estimated wait).

Andrew: Also add soft-degradation mode: when free_slots < 5, shrink interactive token_limit to 8k to preserve headroom. This is aggressive but necessary to keep p99 interactive under SLA.

Mohit: Implemented dynamic gate: cross_region_allowed = free_slots_home < 8 && tenant.type == "enterprise" && current_cross_rps < tenant_cross_allowance. Pushing config now.

deploy-bot: policy rolled to prod. change id: roll-2026-03-18-22

ops-bot: dynamic-capacity-steer toggled ON by Andrew. Audit: adc-2f9d

Kira: Monitoring note: escalate to #incidents + SMS if p99 interactive > 2.5s OR cross_region_cost_per_min > 60$.

Mohit: Early signal: after changes, interactive p95 stable and queue depth falling. Cost for cross-region down 48%. Will keep thread updated for next 60m.

Samira: Panel posted: https://dash.redwood/panels/dyn-capacity-steer. Added Retry-After histogram and per-tenant cross_region tokens.

Lucas: QA backfill: fallback quantized mismatch 2/100 samples; within threshold. No rollback needed. Posting samples in doc.

Andrew: Good work. Followups: (1) precompute per-model fallback candidates so switching is O(1) at runtime (2) add minute-level cost caps per-tenant for cross-region routing (3) update runbook with exact thresholds used here.

Kira: I'll update runbook and ping product for SLA wording edits.

Mohit: Leaving monitoring in this thread. If anything spikes, I'll @oncall and escalate.

Andrew: Closing: well let the 15-60m window play out and then decide if any permanent policy changes are warranted. Thanks team.
